Section – 54EC
Long-term capital gains earned on Immovable Property.
About the Exemption:
Capital gains must be invested in bonds that are redeemable after five years and issued by the Rural Electrification Corporation (REC) / Power Finance Corporation (PFC) / Indian Railway Finance Corporation (IRFC) / Housing and Urban Development Corporation Limited (HUDCO).
Conditions for Exemption:
Amount must be invested within 6 months from date of sale or due date of return filing, whichever is earlier.
Assesses cannot claim deduction of more than ₹50 Lakhs per transaction.
Capital Gains Bonds Features:
Lock-in period of 5 years.
Interest from these bonds is taxable as per slab rate (current interest rate is 5.25% p.a.)

Set Off & Carry Forward
Long-term capital loss can be set off only against long-term capital gains
Short-term capital loss can be set off against both short-term and long-term capital gains
Such loss can be carried forward for 8 assessment years immediately succeeding the assessment year in which the loss was first computed
Such loss cannot be carried forward unless return is filed within the time limit of section 139 (1)

C6=The Sharma family is reviewing various investments and asset transactions completed during FY 2025–26. Their Personal Finance Professional has been asked to calculate the applicable capital gains and tax treatment for each transaction.
B7=1a) · C7=Sale of Listed Equity Shares

Mrs. Sharma purchased 2,000 shares of GreenWave Industries Ltd. on 18 September 2016 at ₹75 per share. The Fair Market Value (FMV) of the shares as on 31 January 2018 was ₹110 per share. She sold all the shares on 12 February 2026 for ₹360 per share.

Calculate Mrs. Sharma’s long-term capital gains (LTCG) & Tax Liability as per applicable tax rules for FY 2025–26.

Redemption of Equity Mutual Fund

Mrs. Sharma invested ₹1,00,000 in XYZ Largecap Equity Mutual Fund on 15 Aug 2025 at NAV of 200. She redeemed her entire investments on 15 March 2026 for NAV of 220.

Calculate Mrs. Sharma’s short-term capital gains (STCG) & Tax Liability as per applicable tax rules for FY 2025–26. · I7=1) LTCG = 5,00,000 & Tax Liability = 46,875
2) STCG = 10,000 & Tax Liability = 2,000

[page 1]
 
 
QPFP Level III Examination Notification 
As per the QPFP program structure and standards, we shall hold level examinations soon after 
completing all the sessions of each level. This will help all candidates test themselves on what they have 
learned and prepare for the ultimate QPFP Final Exam. Below are the details; 
Level Exam Details 
 
Live Exam Date - August 22nd (Saturday) | Timings – 9:30 to 11:30 a.m. 
 
Candidates are advised to take the exam live if Saturday timing is suitable and if prepared well. 
Open Exam Dates – August 22nd (Saturday) to August 28th (Friday) 
 
Candidates may also attempt the level exams at their convenience within one week. 
 
Testing Platform - Online on NFP Learning Platform (Similar to the way Topic Tests are given) 
Level Exam Pattern 
 
● Topics - All Topics & ProTools Covered under the Level III 
● No. of Questions - 64 Questions 
● Weightage - 24 Questions of 1 Mark * 24 Questions of 2 Marks * 16 Questions of 3 Marks 
● Total Marks - 120 Marks 
● Time Allotted – 2 Hours (120 Minutes) 
● Passing Score - 60% (72 Marks) 
● Negative Marking - 25% for incorrect answers 
● Please note: Correct Answers to Level Exam Questions will not be shared with candidates. Also, clearing all 
level exams is mandatory to become eligible for the QPFP Final Exam. 
Exam Fees

: Correct Answers to Level Exam Questions will not be shared with candidates. Also, clearing all 
level exams is mandatory to become eligible for the QPFP Final Exam. 
Exam Fees 
 
● FREE – for the first attempt, either live or within the open dates mentioned above 
● ₹850+ GST – for late attempts beyond open dates or repeat attempts if failed 
How to Prepare for the Exam? 
● Complete watching all pending sessions (if any) under Level III 
● Attempt all pending topic tests under Level III 
● Revise/practice on specific areas where you may be weak 
● Revise your Notes / PPTs / Handouts before the exam 
● Appear for the Level Mock Exam before appearing for the exam 
Testing is an important component of any Professional Certification Program; we request that all 
candidates take it seriously and attempt exams ethically with self-supervision. 
 
Once you attempt all the TopicTests and clear the Level Examination, the Level Badge will be unlocked. 
Regards | Network FP Team
